sections.heading: Montehue's Tolivane
sections.text:
A Tolivane Amulet was once in the possession of Dante Vale and was given to Montehue in their youth. [Two Powers Become One]

Tolivane was invoked by Montehue in the Temple of Thor to hold off the Guardians of Thor in order to allow Montuehue and Dante time to utilize Mjolnir to defeat Ymir. [Two Powers Become One]

In Ethiopia, Tolivane was invoked to defend Montehue against Ashtoreth. Later, inside King Solomon's mines, Tolivane was invoked to defend against the the Organization's forces. After absorbing a Suit's Poisonfang attack, Tolivane was defeated by Rassimov's Kopesh. [To Be Together]

sections.heading: Hubbs' Tolivane
sections.wikitext: Another Tolivane Amulet is in the possession of a [[Suit]] named [[Charlene Hubbs]]. She used her Tolivane to obtain food at a restaurant, thus frightening the other customers. {{Source|OAL-066}}
sections.text: Another Tolivane Amulet is in the possession of a Suit named Charlene Hubbs. She used her Tolivane to obtain food at a restaurant, thus frightening the other customers. [OAL-066]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Tolivane is able to roll and bounce like a ball at top speed. Although he doesn't possess any weapons or attacking abilities, Tolivane can withstand more attacks than his appearance would suggest before he returns to his amulet. With his '''Defense''' ability, he can use his stocky body as a magical sheild and absorb high intensity energy beams. {{Source|S1E23}}

full_text:
Tolivane are small, fairy-like Titans somewhat resembling moles. Although their base stats are relatively low, their "Defense" ability allows them to survive attacks which would normally send them back to their Amulets.

== History ==
Tolivane were strange fairy-like creatures of European folklore that were helpful to good people and wicked when serving evil folk.

=== Montehue's Tolivane ===
A Tolivane Amulet was once in the possession of Dante Vale and was given to Montehue in their youth. [Two Powers Become One]

Tolivane was invoked by Montehue in the Temple of Thor to hold off the Guardians of Thor in order to allow Montuehue and Dante time to utilize Mjolnir to defeat Ymir. [Two Powers Become One]

In Ethiopia, Tolivane was invoked to defend Montehue against Ashtoreth. Later, inside King Solomon's mines, Tolivane was invoked to defend against the the Organization's forces. After absorbing a Suit's Poisonfang attack, Tolivane was defeated by Rassimov's Kopesh. [To Be Together]

=== Hubbs' Tolivane ===
Another Tolivane Amulet is in the possession of a Suit named Charlene Hubbs. She used her Tolivane to obtain food at a restaurant, thus frightening the other customers. [OAL-066]

== Abilities ==
Tolivane is able to roll and bounce like a ball at top speed. Although he doesn't possess any weapons or attacking abilities, Tolivane can withstand more attacks than his appearance would suggest before he returns to his amulet. With his Defense ability, he can use his stocky body as a magical sheild and absorb high intensity energy beams. [S1E23]
